description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
Rin and Seri triggers twice, creating a 1/1 Cat and a 1/1 Dog creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Cat token, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times, tapping the Dog token and Universal Automaton respectively.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Universal Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
